text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening thesis and repeated “No” stance","quality":"argument focus","description":"It states a direct position immediately and keeps the essay consistently aimed at persuading the reader."},{"evidence":"“safety precautions such as: senors... vibrations on the seat”","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"It more explicitly draws on details from the article to support its claims."},{"evidence":"“the technology fails and some is injured, who is at fault-the driver or the manufactuer?”","quality":"reasoning development","description":"It develops a cause-and-effect concern by explaining how driverless cars could lead to legal and practical problems."},{"evidence":"four separate body paragraphs with distinct points","quality":"organization","description":"It separates ideas into a clearer argumentative structure rather than piling all concerns into one block."},{"evidence":"“Although, having driverless cars sounds pretty cool...”","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends with a closing statement that restates the position and briefly synthesizes the main reasons."}]}
